'''Experiment 637''' was a [[mutant]] [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] that roamed [[Nathema]] after the destruction of the [[Sanitarium]]. During the [[Mission to Nathema (Zildrog)|Zildrog Crisis]] it attacked and was killed by the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Lana Beniko]].<ref name="TOR" />
